audience: HR managers and people teams who run time off, timesheets and onboarding in kiwiHR

useCases.title: See who is off and what time off is left
useCases.text: The AI reads who took or requested time off in a date range, and the time off balances per employee: allowance, used, planned and available days.

useCases.title: List the employees of a team with managers
useCases.text: The AI lists employees filtered by team, location, position or active state, with position, manager and employment dates.

useCases.title: Compare expected and tracked time
useCases.text: The AI reads attendance statements for all employees or one: expected and tracked time, time off, holidays, overtime and time per project.

useCases.title: Review a timesheet and add or update an entry
useCases.text: The AI reads the daily timesheets of an employee in a date range, then adds a time entry or changes an existing one.

useCases.title: Add a new employee and an onboarding journey
useCases.text: The AI creates an employee record, then creates an onboarding journey from a journey type and template. The journey is not published.

useCases.title: Deactivate or reactivate an employee
useCases.text: The AI deactivates an employee who left, so they lose access to kiwiHR, or reactivates them. Both steps can be reversed.
